manifest.name: Quantum
manifest.author: Echo Opera
manifest.description: Astrophysics and quantum mechanics rendered from real equations: black holes, jets, supernovae, wavefunctions, orbitals and fusion plasma.

styles.name: Event Horizon
styles.blurb: Photon paths bend around a black hole: a Doppler-beamed accretion disk, its lensed far side and the photon ring.

styles.name: Quasar Jet
styles.blurb: A feeding supermassive black hole fires relativistic jets; bright knots race out along a kinking helix.

styles.name: Supernova
styles.blurb: A star swells, collapses and detonates; a Rayleigh-Taylor shock shell tears outward and cools into a remnant.

styles.name: Pulsar
styles.blurb: A spinning neutron star sweeps twin lighthouse beams through its magnetosphere and wind nebula.

styles.name: Wormhole
styles.blurb: An Einstein-Rosen throat: one sky lensed around the rim, another universe glowing through it, or fly the tunnel.

styles.name: Nebula Genesis
styles.blurb: A volumetric stellar nursery: emission gas, dark pillars and newborn stars under a drifting camera.

styles.name: Gravitational Wave
styles.blurb: Two black holes spiral in and merge; the chirp ripples outward across a spacetime grid.

styles.name: Wavefunction
styles.blurb: A 2D quantum harmonic oscillator: superposed eigenstates slosh through the well, density as light and phase as colour.

styles.name: Double Slit
styles.blurb: Wavefronts pass two slits and interfere; single particles land one at a time and the fringes build up.

styles.name: Orbitals
styles.blurb: Hydrogen probability clouds rendered volumetrically; a superposition sloshes at the transition frequency.

styles.name: Quantum Foam
styles.blurb: Spacetime froth at the Planck scale: iridescent bubbles form and pop while virtual pairs flicker into being.

styles.name: Entanglement
styles.blurb: Pairs fly apart joined by a shared thread; measure one and both states snap, always opposite.

styles.name: Feynman Paths
styles.blurb: Every path from source to detector at once: phases swirl, and the classical path emerges where they agree.

styles.name: Bubble Chamber
styles.blurb: Charged particles spiral through a magnetic field, bleeding energy into tightening curls while pairs fork in Vs.

styles.name: Cosmic Web
styles.blurb: An endless flight into the dark-matter scaffold: filaments, clusters and galaxies at every scale.

styles.name: Galaxy Collision
styles.blurb: Two spirals swing past each other; tides pull their arms into long luminous tails and bridges.

styles.name: Solar Corona
styles.blurb: A limb-darkened star boils with granulation while magnetic loops, prominences and streamers flow above it.

styles.name: Tokamak
styles.blurb: A burning plasma torus confined by twisted field lines; D-shaped coils ring it as edge bursts flicker.
